snippet.description:
In this video, Santosh Sir explains why aspirants must focus on strong fundamentals rather than depending excessively on elimination techniques and shortcuts.

Explore PMP 2027:
https://shorturl.at/ZHr3s

The 2023 Prelims paper highlighted how unpredictable UPSC can be. If familiar elimination techniques fail, conceptual clarity becomes your biggest strength.

Key takeaways:
- Why elimination techniques alone are not enough.
- What the 2023 Prelims paper teaches us.
- Why strong fundamentals matter more than shortcuts.
- How consistent MCQ practice helps develop elimination skills.

At LevelUp IAS, the focus is on building conceptual clarity through structured classes and extensive MCQ practice. Techniques should develop through strong fundamentals, not replace them.

#upsc2027  #upscprelims2027  #upscprelimsstrategy  #PMP2027 #PrelimsMasterProgram #levelupias
